units.source_text: 数栋并排的简陋住房前面，从这头到那头的屋檐下，铺着长长的一道红砖廊道，已经显得有点发黑。

en.t: In front of several simple dwellings standing side by side, beneath the eaves that ran from one end to the other, a long red brick corridor had been laid out, already looking somewhat darkened.
Bats flew back and forth in no particular order.
